29 October 2026
$6.3 BILLION
drained from Binance’s hot wallets in one attack.
The largest crypto theft on record, attributed to North Korea’s TraderTraitor group. If the biggest exchange can’t keep online keys safe, neither can a browser extension.
Sources: Wikipedia, “2026 Binance hack”; TRM Labs (USD 6.36B estimate)
The internet is getting scarier
Online keys are a target. The only safe key is an offline key.
2026 so far
$8.78B
stolen in 328 hacks: a record year, with a month still to go.
Exchanges
Hot wallets
Binance in October, Bitget ($387.5M) in September, Mercado Bitcoin in November. Online signing keys keep getting drained.
Your own wallet
Same risk
A browser wallet keeps your key on the machine that runs every website, extension and download. Malware there signs for you.
Sources: DefiLlama hack list via Altcoin Buzz (to early Nov 2026); exchange incident reports
Even hardware wallets
A wallet bought in a box can be bugged before it reaches you.
$86–93M
stolen in October 2026 from Ledger devices sold by a reseller, CryptoBilis.
A hidden implant read the 24 words off the screen and sent them out over a mobile network.
Ledger’s Genuine Check can’t catch it: it checks only the secure chip.
Bunker: no crypto device in the mail to intercept. You install open-source software on a phone you already own.
Sources: CoinDesk (13 Oct 2026); Halborn; Ledger Donjon threat model. Loss estimates vary by analyst.
So go offline · cold signer for BNB Smart Chain
BUNKER
Turn the old Android phone in your drawer into a hardware wallet. Keys stay offline. MetaMask talks to it through QR codes.
bunker.rotko.net
The idea
Your old phone becomes the bunker.
1
Any Android phone
Android 8 or newer. The one in your drawer works. No new device to buy or ship.
2
Sealed offline
Airplane mode on, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and NFC off. The app has no internet permission at all.
3
QR in, QR out
MetaMask shows the transaction as a QR. Bunker shows the signature back. Nothing else crosses.

8
Setup
From drawer to hardware wallet in four steps.
Step 1
Install Bunker.apk
From bunker.rotko.net (direct APK), foss.rotko.net (F-Droid) or GitHub, with checksums you can verify. Links at bunker.rotko.net.
Step 2
Seal the phone
Airplane mode on. Bunker’s banner turns from “Exposed” to “Bunkered”.
Step 3
Create or import 24 words
Write them down. They are encrypted on the phone under a hardware-backed key.
Step 4
Pair with MetaMask
MetaMask → Add hardware wallet → QR-based. Scan Bunker’s account QR. Done.
9
Clear signing
You see what you sign.
Bunker decodes every transaction on the phone and computes what gets signed itself. Nothing on the screen comes from the online wallet’s description.
  • Every argument of a contract call is shown
  • Unknown tokens, unlimited approvals and high fees are flagged
  • Anything it can’t show in full is refused, never signed blind

11
Security model
Built like a bunker, inside and out.
No way out
The app has no internet permission, so it can’t reach the network even if the phone is online. Screenshots and backups are blocked.
Hardware-sealed seed
The recovery phrase is encrypted under a key in the phone’s secure hardware (StrongBox or TEE). Each signature needs your fingerprint or PIN.
Hostile input assumed
Every QR is treated as an attack: strict, bounded parsers in Rust, checksums verified, BNB Smart Chain’s chain ID enforced.
Open and verifiable
Apache-2.0 source. Signed releases with published checksums. An independent review has already been run on the code.
12
Recommended setup
Best on a Pixel running GrapheneOS.
Best
Pixel 8+ with GrapheneOS
Titan M2 chip, memory tagging, hardened OS.
Good
Pixel 6 or newer
Titan M2 holds the seed key (StrongBox).
Works
Any Android 8+
Key kept in the phone’s TEE. Settings shows which.
Secure chip, not just software
Seed key made inside StrongBox, never exportable. Each signature needs your PIN or fingerprint.
Verified boot
GrapheneOS boots only its own signed system, bootloader locked.
A hardened OS
Hardened memory allocator, memory tagging on Pixel 8+, no Google Play services by default.

Why now
709+
tokenized stocks and ETFs trade 24/7 on BNB Chain.
Ondo, xStocks and Binance’s own bStocks bring real-world equities on-chain. People holding their portfolio in self-custody need a vault that is safe and simple.
Source: BNB Chain blog, “BNB Street is open 24/7: access 709+ tokenized stocks and ETFs”
The hard part
Clear signing only works if it keeps up.
Every new DEX, router upgrade or token issuer changes what a transaction looks like. A signer that can’t read it must refuse it, or users drift back to blind signing.
Measure
Watch the chain
Sample BNB Chain continuously to see which contracts real wallets call, and how much Bunker can already show.
Describe
Write and review
Describe each contract in the open ERC-7730 format, test it on real transactions, and give it back to the public registry.
Ship
Update without an app release
Signed descriptor and token updates, scanned into the offline phone and verified there.
